# Wlad.me

> Personal site of Wlad, a senior UI engineer. Boring SaaS is a dated series of revenue notes on software products.

## Boring SaaS

- [Boring SaaS](https://www.wlad.me/blog): Wlad's notebook of boring software that already makes money. Every number has a date, and he says whether it came from a payment company or from the company itself.
- [About these notes](https://www.wlad.me/blog/about): How Stripe-verified and self-reported labels work.
